user.description: Pick a discovered Powerpal — or choose 'Enter address manually' if yours isn't currently advertising (battery devices like Powerpal advertise sparsely).

manual.description: Enter the Powerpal's Bluetooth MAC address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). You can find it in the Powerpal phone app.

settings.description: Configure Powerpal {name}. The pairing code is in the Powerpal phone app under device settings (a decimal number up to 8 digits).

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

init.description: Adjust meter calibration or notification cadence. To change the pairing code, remove and re-add the integration.
